When noRate, P&L shows '—' but in red (#F87171) because color still uses demo-based unrealized_pnl. Use neutral color when noRate.

Green '▲ 0%' change badges still shown next to '—' rates, and footer note says 'Market feed is not connected yet — showing indicative rates' although no rates are shown. Hide badge / reword note when has_live=false.
